findings.title: Reuse cached FormData in parseBody instead of re-serializing it
findings.trigger: A handler or middleware calls `await c.req.formData()` and then `await c.req.parseBody()` on the same request; parseFormData now always calls `request.arrayBuffer()`, and with only `bodyCache.formData` set, HonoRequest rebuilds the buffer via `new Response(formData)` under a new multipart boundary.
findings.impact: That buffer is parsed with the original Content-Type, so multipart bodies now throw `Failed to parse body as FormData` (500) where the base succeeded, and urlencoded bodies return a corrupted key made of the boundary text.
findings.change: In `parseFormData` in `src/utils/body.ts`, when the request is a `HonoRequest` with `bodyCache.formData` already set, await and use that FormData; otherwise keep the `arrayBuffer()` plus `bufferToFormData` path. Add a regression test for `formData()` followed by `parseBody()`.
findings.source: Issue #5060, expected behavior: boundaries and parameters remain intact.

observations.fact: parseBody now handles a body already cached as text or json, which failed at the base with a Content-Type error.
observations.evidence: Scratch repro: text-then-parseBody returned 200 at head and 500 at the merge-base sources.
